title: Microarray-Based Quantification of Cellular tRNAs
author: Sebastian Kirchner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.hfcb3iw
materials: tRNAs-containing total RNA can be extracted using various procedures, each depending on the type of cells which will be analyzed and the experimental setup. We routinely extract total RNA from 10 7 mammalian cells or 100 mg tissue samples using TRIzol (ThermoFisher, #15596018). For more information on the TRIzol Reagent please consult the ThermoFisher homepage. Please see the attached file for the standard TRIzol extraction protocol. RNA extraction protocols selecting against small RNAs should be avoided (e.g. LiCl based extraction). https://www.thermofisher.com/uk/en/home.html

For labeling, prepare the following 2x labeling mix: 2 µl 10x T4 ligation buffer (NEB, #M0202), 3 µl DMSO (Sigma, #D8418), 1 µl Cy3/Atto647 labeled 25-mer oligonucleotide (90 µM, Microsynth), 1 µl T4 DNA ligase (NEB, #M0202) and 3 µl H 2 O. Note: In previous attempts we used Cy5 instead of Atto647. However, in our hands Cy5 appears to be highly ozone sensitive and hence not suitable to be used for tRNA microarrays.

Hybridization of fluorescently labeled tRNA samples onto tRNA microarrays is performed using a Hyb4 Microarray Hybridization System (Digilab). Please refer to the manufacture's homepage for more information (see link). Before starting, clean the plastic parts forming the hybridization chamber with RNase AWAY Decontamination Reagent (ThermoFisher, #10328011) and subsequently rinse extensively with RNase-free H 2 O. Dry the cleaned chamber parts, assemble the hybridization chambers using dummy slides and place them in the Hyb4 Microarray Hybridization Machine. Wash the machine using the pre-programmed washing protocol. Once the cleaning procedure is completed, place the required number of microarray slides upright into a beaker filled with boiling RNase-free H 2 O and boil for 2-5 min. Dry the microarray slides, remove dummy slides from the hybridization chambers and insert the microarray slides. Note: the Hyb4 Microarray Hybridization System allows the simultaneous hybridization of 4 independent microarrays. The system is now ready to perform the hybridization reaction and subsequent wash steps. http://https://www.digilabglobal.com/

Prior to the hybridization reaction, mix Cy3 and Atto647 labeled tRNAs as follows: Combine 1-2 µg RNA containing Cy3 labeled tRNAs, 1-2 µg RNA containing Atto647 labeled tRNAs, 1.5 µl poly (A) (20 mg/ml, GE Healtcare, #27-4110-01) and 3 µl UltraPure Salmon Sperm DNA Solution (10 mg/ml; ThermoFisher, #15632011). Add PerfectHyb Plus solution (Sigma, #H7033) to a final volume of 180 µl. Keep away from light. Note: For exact quantification equal amounts of labeled tRNAs must be combined.

steps.title: Assess RNA Quality and Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine total RNA concentration using a NanoDrop 2000 spectrophotometer. If phenol contamination is detected (low 260/230 ratio), clean RNA with RNA Clean & Concentrator-5 columns (Zymo Research, #R1015). Verify RNA integrity using a RNA 6000 Nano chip on a 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent) or a denaturing formamide/agarose gel; only use RNA with a RIN >8.

steps.title: Prepare tRNA Standards
steps.instruction: Use in vitro transcribed tRNA standards (S. cerevisiae tRNA Phe3, E. coli tRNA Lys2, and E. coli tRNA Tyr2). Refold and store standards at -80°C until use.

steps.title: Deacetylate tRNAs and Spike-in Standards
steps.instruction: Perform deacetylation of 1-5 μg total RNA in a total volume of 20 µl.

substeps.instruction: Combine 1-5 μg total RNA, 0.8 pmol of each tRNA standard per μg of total RNA, and 2 µl Tris/HCl (1 M, pH 9.0).
Adjust the final volume to 20 µl using RNase-free H2O.
Add one volume of neutralisation buffer (100 mM NaOAc, 100 mM NaCl, pH 4.8) and 2.7 volumes of 100% ethanol.
Incubate for 30 min at -80°C.
Centrifuge for 30 min at 21,000 x g (4°C).
Resuspend the RNA pellet in 10 µl RNase-free H2O.
Store at -80°C or proceed to labeling.

steps.title: Label tRNAs
steps.instruction: Selectively label tRNAs from different conditions using Cy3 or Atto647 labeled 25-mer oligonucleotide hairpins (reconstituted in TE buffer pH 8.0 at 90 µM).

substeps.instruction: Combine 10 µl of deacetylated tRNAs with 10 µl 2x labeling mix.
Incubate for at least 16h at 16°C in the dark.

steps.title: Purify Labeled tRNAs
steps.instruction: Perform phenol-chloroform purification of the labeled tRNAs in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 µl Crush & Soak buffer (50 mM KOAc, 200 mM KCl, pH 7.0) to the ligation mixture, vortex, and add 100 µl phenol/chloroform/IAA (Carl Roth, #156.3).
Centrifuge for 15 min at 21,000 x g (4°C).
Recover the upper aqueous phase and add 2.7 volumes 100% ethanol.
Incubate for 30 min at -80°C.
Centrifuge for 30 min at 21,000 x g (4°C).
Resuspend the pellet in 20 µl RNase-free H2O.
Optional: Analyze 2 µl of labeled tRNAs on a denaturing 10% TBE-PAGE to verify labeling efficiency (labeled tRNAs ~100 nts vs unlabeled 70-80 nts).

steps.title: Perform Microarray Hybridization
steps.instruction: Run the hybridization reaction using a Hyb4 machine, covered with foil to prevent photobleaching.

substeps.instruction: O-Ring conditioning: 75°C for 2 min.
Introduce sample: hold at 60°C.
Denature sample: 90°C for 5 min.
Hybridization: 60°C for 16 h with agitation on.
Wash I: 50°C flow 10 s, hold 20 s (Wash buffer 1: 2x SSC, 0.1% SDS).
Wash II: 42°C flow 10 s, hold 20 s (Wash buffer 2: 0.1x SSC, 0.1% SDS).
Wash III: 42°C flow 10 s, hold 20 s (Wash buffer 3: 0.1x SSC).
Note: 20x SSC buffer consists of 3 M NaCl and 300 mM Tri-sodium citrate, pH 7.0.

steps.title: Wash and Dry Microarrays
steps.instruction: Process the microarrays after hybridization, keeping them protected from light.

substeps.instruction: Remove microarrays from chambers and place in a 50 ml Falcon tube.
Wash 2x with wash buffer 3 under gentle agitation for 5 min at room temperature.
Transfer to a fresh 50 ml Falcon tube and dry by centrifugation at 200 x g for 15 min at room temperature.
Store dried slides in a foil-wrapped slide box at 4°C until readout.

steps.title: Scan and Quantify Microarrays
steps.instruction: Quantify fluorescence intensities using a GenePix 4200A microarray scanner and GenePix Pro 7 software.

substeps.instruction: Record Cy3 fluorescence at 532 nm excitation and Atto647 at 635 nm excitation.
Set 'Wavelength Channel Color' to 'Rainbow 2'.
Calculate background-subtracted mean fluorescence values.
Determine average values for each tRNA probe across all 12 blocks and spots.
Calculate tRNA levels as Atto647/Cy3 ratios.
